verdict.rationale: The only evidence of acting on many items at once is the security guidance to delete a whole container tag's content via the API or console workflow, a scoped bulk delete. The documented document operations (list/get/update/delete) are per-document, and connector auto-sync is ingestion rather than a bulk operation. Missing for 10: a documented bulk/batch API for adding, updating or deleting many items, bulk operations by metadata filter, batch limits and semantics, and any hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
